AXONIUS_QUERY.description: Axonius Query Language (AQL) filter forwarded verbatim to the data.attributes.filter slot on POST /api/V4.0/assets/devices and POST /api/V4.0/assets/users. Free-form AQL — example: ("specific_data.data.os.type" == "Windows") and ("specific_data.data.last_seen" > date("NOW - 30d")). Optional; Axonius v4 interprets an empty filter as 'all assets'. Whitespace is trimmed.

AXONIUS_FIELDS.description: Comma-separated list of Axonius dotted field paths forwarded to the data.attributes.fields.{devices|users} slot on each surface. Empty / blank falls back to a curated default field set per entity (hostname, ips, mac, os.os_str, os.distribution, os.type, last_seen, first_seen, adapter_list_length, labels for devices; username, mail, domain, last_seen, is_admin, is_disabled, adapter_list_length, labels for users). Example: specific_data.data.hostname,specific_data.data.network_interfaces.ips,specific_data.data.os.type. Forwarded verbatim — the operator may include tenant-specific adapter fields.

name: axonius
title: Axonius
description: Axonius asset-inventory importer. Pulls devices and users that match an Axonius Query Language (AQL) expression from the Axonius v4 REST API and emits Faraday bulk-create JSON. Each Axonius asset becomes one Faraday host — the device's first non-loopback IP maps onto host.ip (users get the 0.0.0.0 sentinel because Axonius user entities are identity-keyed, not IP-keyed), the canonical hostname / adapter_count / last_seen enrichment lands on host.description, and the asset itself becomes one Faraday vulnerability with the [ASSET-INVENTORY] engine prefix so the data lands in the Faraday workspace alongside the other CMDB-class feeds (Device42, Fleet, runZero, Armis, Jamf Pro, Jira Insight). Endpoints used: POST /api/V4.0/assets/devices (paginated device inventory; request body is the canonical Axonius v4 search envelope {"data": {"type": "entity_request_schema", "attributes": {"filter": "<AXONIUS_QUERY>", "fields": {"devices": [...]}, "page": {"limit": 100, "offset": N}, "use_cursor": false}}}; response envelope is JSON-API {"data": [{"type": "device", "id": "...", "attributes": {...}}], "meta": {"page": {"total": N}}}) and POST /api/V4.0/assets/users (same envelope shape, fields block scoped to users). Walked page-by-page until len(data) < limit or AXONIUS_PAGES (env-only override, default 5, clamped to [1, 50]) is reached. Severity is always info because Axonius hits are inventory entries, not vulnerability findings — operators correlate against the EDR / EASM / vuln-scanner agents' findings via the Axonius-Id / Axonius-InternalId refs. Auth: Axonius v4 uses a pair of long-lived credentials (API Key + API Secret) created in the Axonius console under Account -> API Key. The dispatcher carries them on every request as the api-key and api-secret headers — Axonius v4 explicitly does NOT use Authorization: Bearer / Basic. AXONIUS_HOST is the Axonius tenant host (e.g. axonius.mycorp.com); on-prem deployments override it. Tags: [axonius, asset-inventory, device|user].
